_comment: GOLDEN wire-shape snapshot of the auditloop plugin-push `metadata` body that this harness emits. It exists to make DRIFT between the harness's hand-mirrored structs (e2e/uxaudit/push.go: PushPayload/PushPage/PushFinding) and auditloop's REAL schema fail a TEST, not a live push. The json KEYS below must match auditloop's server field names exactly (viewport values mobile|desktop; finding.type in a11y|console|network|perf|layout|other). Mirrored from auditloop internal/plugin/schema.go @ commit ae07238 (2026-07-30) — the `a11y_digest` field below did NOT exist at df153b0, which this comment used to cite; df153b0 stays correct for the VENDORED SCRIPT only (e2e/uxaudit/a11y.go A11yDigestSource), a11y-digest.js being unchanged since. Re-verified against auditloop main @ d19b8a3 (2026-08-17): schema.go unchanged since ae07238. The OPTIONAL `a11y_digest` ref names this view's bounded DOM/accessibility digest part (a11y-digest.js output, vendored verbatim in e2e/uxaudit/a11y-digest.js); auditloop validates it strictly and REJECTS an all-empty digest, so the harness omits the ref entirely for a page whose digest carries no elements — and since #47 (d19b8a3) an attached digest ALSO bounds which selectors a mechanical a11y finding may cite, so an under-describing digest deletes true findings (see a11y.go). `url` is the STABLE per-view identity the P2 diff matches on; this harness emits it VIEWPORT-QUALIFIED (`<view>@<viewport>`) — see the PAGE IDENTITY note in push.go. auditloop's PushPage additionally accepts OPTIONAL `perf` and `layout` measurement blocks (omitempty); this harness deliberately does NOT emit them, so they are absent here by design. When you re-mirror, bump this comment's commit/date and update push.go together.
